spec.kitLine: Activates when firing the last bullet
spec.assertion: SPEC.critTrigger === 'lastBullet' plus a counterfactual patching the trigger to shotFired; the wrong model reaches the stack cap in the first fraction of a second instead of after ~3 magazines and strictly out-damages the faithful one (SHOT_FIRED.dmg[k] > BASE.dmg[k]).

Every critRatePct buffApply targeting k uses the UNSCOPED stat, never critRateNormalPct — the nearest-wrong scoping would exclude her burst-window damage and her 23.9% rider from the crit roll. Also asserts self-only (no ally receives the same-valued apply).

value x maxStacks must land in [20, 75.5] — the kit ceiling is 100 x 0.75% = 75%. Fails under a 21.75-per-apply value left at maxStacks 100 (2175%) or an uncapped buff. Backed by an UNCAPPED counterfactual proving the cap is load-bearing (uncapped > base).

durationSec is undefined on the stack buff — 'continuously' plus an explicit FB-end removal line means Full Burst ending is the only intended end condition; any durationSec is an invented second expiry.

it.skip — no stacks-per-application primitive exists. Either the ramp is faithful and the ceiling is 65.25% (21.75 x 3), or the ceiling is 75% and the ramp needs 100 magazines. The ceiling assertion tolerates both readings; the trajectory is unpinnable without a stacksPerApply field.

spec.kitLine: Deals 23.9% of final ATK as add. dmg
spec.assertion: Exactly one skill1 block carries a flatDamage at atkPct 23.9; splicing it out drops k's total (non-vacuity — proves it resolves rather than dying on an empty enemy target set) while every teammate total stays byte-identical (inertness).

spec.kitLine: when pellets land a critical hit 4x
spec.assertion: Live part: trigger.kind === 'hitCount' with count >= 4 (4 crits cost at least 4 hits at any sub-100% crit rate) — fails under interval/shotFired. Skipped part: the crit gate itself has no primitive, and the true cadence is non-stationary because Tilted Scale raises crit as the fight runs.

spec.kitLine: Full Burst ends: Removes Tilted Scale
spec.assertion: it.skip — the effect schema has no buff-removal kind (buffRemove fires only for removeOnReload). Tilted Scale never resets, so k holds capped Critical Rate after the first few magazines instead of rebuilding post-FB. Direction: OVER-CREDIT, growing with Full Burst count.

value is negative and close to -51.13 (a positive sign would invert the kit's whole last-bullet feedback loop), expiresFrame is a real frame with durationShots absent (timed, not permanent, not round-counted), and stacks <= 1 ('similar effects cannot be stacked').

The set of targetSlugs on 10.62-valued attackDamagePct applies covers EVERY slug in the comp — a self-scoped mis-encoding fails. Magnitude filtering keeps it separate from the burst's own 21.12% self buff.

trigger.kind === 'lastBullet' and target.kind === 'allies' — Tilted Scale is gained on the last bullet, so a fullBurstEnter/burstCast keying would fire a handful of times per fight instead of once per magazine. Plus the feedback assertion: base (ammo halved) produces strictly MORE Fulfillment applications to k than a run with the ammo debuff removed, proving the smaller magazine actually raises last-bullet frequency.
it.skip — same missing removal primitive. Partly self-limiting via the 10s duration; net direction ambiguous since the line strips a damage buff AND an ammo penalty together.
A weaponSwap effect exists in the burst slot with damagePct 92.5 and durationSec 10; removing only the swap (keeping both stat buffs) must DROP k's total.

Encoding-agnostic: either the swap carries pullsPerSec < 10 or a co-active attackSpeedPct <= -90 buff exists. Neither present means the swap fires at the base SMG rate — a roughly 10x over-credit on the burst window.

it.skip (ALWAYS-FLAG: multi-projectile split-vs-merge + swap shot economy are kit-silent). Indirectly probed by the swap-is-a-gain assertion: 92.5% x 10 pellets at the slowed cadence beats the base SMG, whereas a merged single-92.5%-shot reading makes the burst a net LOSS and turns that test red.
The casterAtkPct buffApply on k emits a FLAT-resolved ATK number (> 1000), not the raw 63.36 percentage; and no other slug receives the same-valued apply (self-scope inertness).
Every 21.12-valued attackDamagePct apply targets k alone — discriminates against an allies-scoped mis-encoding, and the magnitude filter keeps it distinct from the skill2 team-wide 10.62%.

fixtures: controlComp('k', false) for every run — liter (B1) + crown (B2) + k (B3). B1+B2 are mandatory because a lone Burst III makes ZERO Full Bursts, which would render every burst/FB assertion vacuous. The fixed B3 slot is deliberately dropped: it is a second Burst III competing for the same rotation slot (k might not cast every rotation) AND it carries a critRateNormalPct ally buff that would contaminate every Tilted-Scale crit reading. Six hoisted 180s runs: BASE, SHOT_FIRED (S1a trigger -> shotFired), UNCAPPED (maxStacks -> 10000), NO_RIDER (23.9% block spliced out), NO_AMMO (maxAmmoPct effect stripped, Attack Damage kept), NO_SWAP (weaponSwap stripped, burst stat buffs kept). Structure is read once from a throwaway withPatchedOverride clone. NOTE: the packet gives two contradictory override-file shapes (slot -> Block[] vs slot -> CharacterSkills.blocks[]), so slotBlocks() accepts both and all counterfactuals mutate the array in place.
gaps: skill1 'Removes Tilted Scale' on Full Burst end — no buff-removal effect kind exists (buffRemove is emitted only for removeOnReload); stacks never reset, so k holds capped crit for the rest of the fight. OVER-CREDIT that grows with Full Burst count.

skill2 'Removes Fulfillment of Righteousness' on Full Burst end — same missing removal primitive; partly masked by the 10s duration, net direction ambiguous (strips a damage buff and an ammo penalty together).

skill1 '+29 Tilted Scale stacks per activation, cap 100' — no stacks-per-application primitive; the author must sacrifice either the 75% ceiling (21.75 x 3 = 65.25%) or the ~3-magazine ramp (0.75 x 100).
skill1 '23.9% rider on 4 CRITICAL hits' — hitCount has no crit gate; any threshold is a crit-rate-derived estimate, and it is non-stationary because Tilted Scale raises k's crit rate over the fight.
burst 'Pelletcount: 10' — kit-silent split-vs-merge (ALWAYS-FLAG); per-pellet vs whole-shot 92.5% changes the burst by an order of magnitude and is resolvable only from footage popup counts/values.
